Reading Text

ملخص القراءة
Reading Passage · نص القراءة
Foods from the Americas
أطعمة من الأمريكتين
🔊 Reading aloud... (0/0) 00:00
Speed: 0.9×
👆 Touch or hover any word to see its Arabic translation instantly.  |  المسّ أي كلمة لترى ترجمتها فوراً
Tomatoes

Tomatoes are native to Mexico and Central America. The Aztecs grew them in the eighth century. In the 16th century, Spanish explorers introduced tomatoes to Spain. Popularity spread throughout Europe. The French, Germans, and Italians absolutely loved them. But the British thought they were poisonous at first. In the nineteenth century, tomatoes reached the Middle East. Egypt is now one of the top producers.

Avocado

The Aztecs cultivated the avocado, an oily fruit rich in vitamins. It must be picked before it ripens to reach full maturity. Sailors called it "seaman's butter" because it lasts during long voyages. It is the treasured main ingredient in guacamole.

Chocolate

When Spanish explorers arrived in Mexico, the Aztecs gave them chocolate as a royal welcome. Emperor Moctezuma drank 50 cups a day from a gold cup. In the 19th century, Swiss creators created the first bar of chocolate. Nowadays, very few people can resist this sweet food.
